X8 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
The winner was selected on A549 and A549 alone. That protects against choosing a
statistic by its dendritic-cell answer; it does NOT protect against choosing one
that suits A549's particular kinetics. A statistic tuned on one system and applied
to another is a weaker instrument than one derived from first principles, and the
four candidates here are conveniences rather than a theory of transcription timing.
X4 varies which four points are used but every subset comes from the same A549
series, so it tests robustness to sampling and not to biology.
mrt and centroid are defined over the OBSERVED window, so both are bounded by it. A
gene still moving at the last timepoint has its response time underestimated, and
that bias is larger on the shorter dendritic-cell window than on A549's.
Leading is still not causing. Nothing here perturbs accessibility.
A pass replicates the CLOCK only. Loop 191d's other findings -- feedback sign not
ordering response times, occupancy not carrying timing once size is controlled --
remain single-system results and are untouched by this loop.
